observations: White Sony PlayStation 4 console with 'PS4' and 'SONY' branding visible on the top casing.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are shown; one has a distinctive 'Black Panther' themed skin.
The console is resting on a marble-patterned surface.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAMES' is overlaid on the image.
The console appears to be in a clean, unused condition.

claims.evidence: The specific firmware version is not visible in the photo.
No game discs or digital codes are visible in the photo.
The original controller pads and the UK receipt mentioned in the text are not shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have a storage capacity issue (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'PlayStation Network' screen showing an active account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen to confirm the hard drive size.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate menus.
Photo of the 'PlayStation Network' screen to confirm an active account.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
